## Function Control Contract

The views, the Control interface and the mapping of errors to HTTP status and code.

Behaviour: Declares in control/control.go, exactly, one field per line: `type QueueView struct { State string `json:"state"`; Approved string `json:"approved"`; Index int `json:"index"`; Phases int `json:"phases"`; Current string `json:"current"`; Reason string `json:"reason"` }`; `type Stop struct { Kind string `json:"kind"`; Phase string `json:"phase"`; Reason string `json:"reason"`; IssueURL string `json:"issue_url,omitempty"`; At time.Time `json:"at"` }`; `type Status struct { State string `json:"state"`; Phase string `json:"phase"`; Minutes int `json:"minutes"`; CostUSD float64 `json:"cost_usd"`; FiveHour int `json:"five_hour"`; SevenDay int `json:"seven_day"`; SessionID string `json:"session_id"`; Queue QueueView `json:"queue"`; Repo github.Access `json:"repo"`; Stop *Stop `json:"stop,omitempty"` }`; `type Question struct { RequestID string `json:"request_id"`; Text string `json:"text"`; Header string `json:"header"`; Options []string `json:"options"`; AskedAt time.Time `json:"asked_at"` }`; `type Usage struct { FiveHour int `json:"five_hour"`; SevenDay int `json:"seven_day"`; FiveHourResetsAt int64 `json:"five_hour_resets_at"`; SevenDayResetsAt int64 `json:"seven_day_resets_at"`; SessionCostUSD float64 `json:"session_cost_usd"`; StretchCostUSD float64 `json:"stretch_cost_usd"`; LimitsAt time.Time `json:"limits_at"` }`; `type Events struct { Entries []eventlog.Entry `json:"entries"`; Last int64 `json:"last"` }`; `type ProjectView struct { Name string `json:"name"`; Language string `json:"language"`; RepoURL string `json:"repo_url"`; State string `json:"state"`; CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"` }`; `type Milestone struct { Kind string `json:"kind"`; Headline string `json:"headline"`; Numbers string `json:"numbers"` }`; `type TokenResult struct { Access github.Access `json:"access"`; Pushed bool `json:"pushed"`; PushError string `json:"push_error,omitempty"` }`; `type Control interface { Projects() []ProjectView; CreateProject(ctx context.Context, name, language, repoURL string) (ProjectView, error); Status(project string) (Status, error); Events(project string, since int64, max int) (Events, error); Order(project, text string) (session.OrderResult, error); Pending(project string) (*Question, error); Answer(project string, option int) error; Interrupt(project string) error; Usage(project string) (Usage, error); Restart(project string, force bool) error; PlanLoad(project string, plan queue.Plan) (QueueView, error); Continue(project string) error; StopCheck(project string) (*Stop, error); PutGithubToken(ctx context.Context, project, token string) (TokenResult, error); PhaseDone(project, sessionToken, phase, next string) error; WaitOperator(project, sessionToken, kind, reason, issueURL string) error; Milestone(project, sessionToken string, m Milestone) error }`; the errors `ErrUnknownProject` ("unknown project"), `ErrNoSession` ("no session running"), `ErrBusy` ("session is busy"), `ErrNotWaiting` ("not waiting"), `ErrBadToken` ("session token mismatch"), `ErrBadInput` ("bad input"), `ErrExists` ("project exists") as errors.New of the texts, and `ErrNoQuestion = session.ErrNoQuestion`, `ErrBadOption = session.ErrBadOption`, `ErrNotBusy = session.ErrNotBusy`; anything else → (500, "internal").

- uses: queue
- uses: github
- uses: eventlog
- uses: session
- produces: Status

3. given Question{RequestID: "9f4ffa22-2676-4391-bfd9-bd7d16c3866c", Text: "Which option do you want: A or B?", Header: "A or B", Options: []string{"Option A", "Option B"}, AskedAt: 2026-10-08T13:09:08Z}; when json.Marshal; then exactly {"request_id":"9f4ffa22-2676-4391-bfd9-bd7d16c3866c","text":"Which option do you want: A or B?","header":"A or B","options":["Option A","Option B"],"asked_at":"2026-10-08T13:09:08Z"}
4. given Percent(0.22); Percent(0.6); Percent(0.005); Percent(1.3); Percent(-0.1); Percent(0.995); when Percent; then 22; 60; 1; 100; 0; 100
5. given Code(nil); Code(ErrUnknownProject); Code(fmt.Errorf("wrap: %w", ErrBadOption)); Code(ErrBadToken); Code(ErrExists); Code(ErrNoSession); Code(ErrBusy); Code(ErrNoQuestion); Code(ErrNotBusy); Code(ErrNotWaiting); Code(ErrBadInput); Code(errors.New("disk full")); when Code; then (200, ""); (404, "unknown_project"); (400, "bad_option"); (401, "bad_session_token"); (409, "exists"); (409, "no_session"); (409, "busy"); (409, "no_question"); (409, "not_busy"); (409, "not_waiting"); (400, "bad_input"); (500, "internal")
6. given ErrNoQuestion; ErrBadOption; ErrNotBusy; when compared; then ErrNoQuestion == session.ErrNoQuestion, ErrBadOption == session.ErrBadOption, ErrNotBusy == session.ErrNotBusy (the same variables); var _ Control = (*nilControl)(nil) is not required — the interface has exactly 17 methods

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Claude Behind An Interface: The claude CLI is reached only through claude.Process (stdin lines in, stdout lines out, an exit status); the daemon's tests use claude.Fake fed with lines from tests/fixtures/stream/probe.jsonl, never a real claude.
- Bearer Token On Every Route: Every HTTP route but GET /healthz and the MCP endpoints requires Authorization: Bearer <MORPHD_TOKEN>; /mcp and /mcp/{project} require the same token; /mcp/{project}/session requires that project's current session token. morphd listens on 127.0.0.1 only; TLS and the public name are Caddy's.
- The Session Reports Only Itself: A VPS session can call phase_done, wait_operator and milestone only through its own endpoint /mcp/{project}/session with the token morphd minted for that spawn; the token changes on every spawn, so a past session or another project cannot report.

Guardrails:
- Injected Clock And Ids: No package but cmd/morphd reads the clock or a random source: time comes in as a `now` argument or an injected Now func() time.Time, ids from an injected NewID func() string; time.Now, math/rand and crypto/rand appear only in cmd/morphd. Timers are the daemon's Tick, driven by main's ticker.
- No Network In Tests: Tests never open a listener or dial: HTTP is tested with httptest.NewRecorder and httptest.NewRequest, Telegram and GitHub through an injected Do, the MCP server over in-memory transports; a test writes files only under t.TempDir(); no test runs claude or reaches github.com or api.telegram.org.
- No Shell Outside Runner: os/exec is imported only by package runner (git, morph) and package claude (the claude process); every other package runs commands through runner.Runner and tests script them with runner.Fake.
- Secrets Never Logged: The API token, the session tokens, the GitHub token and the Telegram token never appear in a response body, a log line, a milestone, an error text or the argv of a spawned process; secrets live in files of mode 0600 under the state directory; the git credentials reach git through a credential store file, never through a URL or an argument.

Write the files: `control/control.go`.

Go 1.22, the standard library only (go.mod requires nothing; the build runs with GOPROXY=off). gofmt-formatted (gofmt -l prints nothing) and go vet clean. A file's package is its directory's base name; exported names in MixedCaps; a package imports another of the module by the module path of go.mod + "/" + its directory. ## Function Phase Start Check

fetch, then decide fresh, resume, pull or diverged from main and origin/main.

Behaviour: Declares in gitrules/start.go: `type Start struct { Mode string `json:"mode"`; Branch string `json:"branch"`; Local string `json:"local"`; Remote string `json:"remote"`; Reason string `json:"reason"` }` and `func StartCheck(ctx context.Context, r runner.Runner, dir string) Start`. Mode is one of "fresh", "resume", "diverged", "error". Commands run in dir with env nil, in this order, each through r.Run; a Run error of any command (6 and 7 included), or a non-zero Code of a command marked (!), → Mode "error", Reason "<key> failed: " + strings.TrimSpace(Stderr) (or the Run error's text): 1 (!) git fetch -q origin; 2 (!) git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD → Branch (trimmed); 3 (!) git rev-parse HEAD → Local; 4 (!) git rev-parse origin/main → Remote; 5 (!) git status --porcelain → the dirty paths (non-empty lines). Then: Branch != "main" → Mode "resume", Reason "on branch <branch>"; dirty paths → "resume", "dirty tree (<n> paths)"; Local == Remote → "fresh", Reason ""; else 6 git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD: Code 0 → "resume", "local ahead of origin/main"; else 7 git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main: Code 0 → 8 (!) git pull -q --ff-only → "fresh", Reason "pulled to <remote>", Local = Remote; Code of 7 not 0 → "diverged", Reason "local <local> and origin/main <remote> diverged". No command after the first failure.

Steps:
- uses: runner
- produces: Start

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given f := &runner.Fake{Script: {"git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD": {Stdout: "main\n"}, "git rev-parse HEAD": {Stdout: "aaa111\n"}, "git rev-parse origin/main": {Stdout: "aaa111\n"}, "git status --porcelain": {Stdout: ""}}}; when StartCheck(ctx, f, "/p"); then Start{Mode: "fresh", Branch: "main", Local: "aaa111", Remote: "aaa111", Reason: ""}; f.Calls keys in order "git fetch -q origin", "git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD", "git rev-parse HEAD", "git rev-parse origin/main", "git status --porcelain" (5 calls, every Dir "/p")
2. given the scripts of example 1 but HEAD "bbb222" and "git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD": {Code: 0}; when StartCheck; then Mode "resume", Reason "local ahead of origin/main", Local "bbb222", Remote "aaa111"; 6 calls
3. given HEAD "aaa111", origin/main "ccc333", "git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD": {Code: 1}, "git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main": {Code: 0}, "git pull -q --ff-only": {Code: 0}; when StartCheck; then Mode "fresh", Reason "pulled to ccc333", Local "ccc333", Remote "ccc333"; 8 calls, the last key "git pull -q --ff-only"
4. given as example 3 but both merge-base calls Code 1; when StartCheck; then Mode "diverged", Reason "local aaa111 and origin/main ccc333 diverged"; 7 calls
5. given the scripts of example 1 but "git status --porcelain": {Stdout: " M docs/TASK_P18.md\n?? decks/p18/\n"}; when StartCheck; then Mode "resume", Reason "dirty tree (2 paths)"; 5 calls
6. given the scripts of example 1 but "git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD": {Stdout: "morph/20261008-083312\n"}; when StartCheck; then Mode "resume", Reason "on branch morph/20261008-083312", Branch "morph/20261008-083312"; 5 calls (the status is still read)
7. given &runner.Fake{Script: {"git fetch -q origin": {Code: 128, Stderr: "fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/o/r/': Could not resolve host\n"}}}; when StartCheck; then Mode "error", Reason "git fetch -q origin failed: fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/o/r/': Could not resolve host"; 1 call
8. given &runner.Fake{Errors: {"git fetch -q origin": "runner: exec: \"git\": executable file not found"}}; when StartCheck; then Mode "error", Reason "git fetch -q origin failed: runner: exec: \"git\": executable file not found"

## Function Project Registry

The registry of projects in one JSON file, rewritten whole and atomically, and a JSON state blob per project.

Behaviour: Declares in registry/registry.go: `var ErrNotFound = errors.New("project not found")`, `var ErrExists = errors.New("project exists")`, `var ErrBadName = errors.New("bad project name")`, `var ErrNoState = errors.New("no state")`, `type Project struct { Name string `json:"name"`; Language string `json:"language"`; RepoURL string `json:"repo_url"`; Dir string `json:"dir"`; Caps queue.Caps `json:"caps"`; CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"` }`, `type Registry struct` (unexported fields), `func Open(base string) (*Registry, error)`, `func (r *Registry) Base() string`, `func (r *Registry) Add(p Project) error`, `func (r *Registry) Get(name string) (Project, error)`, `func (r *Registry) List() []Project`, `func (r *Registry) SaveState(name string, v any) error` and `func (r *Registry) LoadState(name string, v any) error`. Open creates base (0o700) when missing and reads base/projects.json: missing → empty; not a JSON array of Project → (nil, an error beginning "registry: read "). Add: Name must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$ else ErrBadName; a stored name → ErrExists; else stored and the whole list written as a JSON array sorted by Name (json.MarshalIndent with two spaces, an empty list as []) to a temporary file in base then renamed onto projects.json. Get → the project or (Project{}, ErrNotFound). List → a new slice sorted by Name (empty non-nil). SaveState writes json.MarshalIndent(v) to base/<name>/state.json (the directory created 0o700; unknown name → ErrNotFound) by temporary file and rename; LoadState unmarshals it into v, missing file → ErrNoState, unknown name → ErrNotFound. Every error of the file system is returned as is (never one of the sentinels). Values are copies.

Steps:
- produces: Project

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given base := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state") (missing); when Open(base); List(); Get("demo"); Base(); then a non-nil *Registry, nil; the directory exists; []Project{} (non-nil, empty); (Project{}, ErrNotFound); base
2. given the registry of example 1; Add({Name "zeta", Language "go", RepoURL "https://github.com/o/zeta", Dir "/p/zeta", Caps {30, 3, 5}, CreatedAt 2026-10-08T15:00:00Z}); Add({Name "alpha", Language "python", …, CreatedAt 2026-10-08T15:01:00Z}); when Add twice, then List, then decode base/projects.json; then both nil; List names in order "alpha", "zeta"; the file decodes (json.Unmarshal into []Project) to exactly List(); the directory base holds only projects.json
3. given the registry after example 2; when Add({Name "alpha"}); Add({Name "Alpha"}); Add({Name "-x"}); Add({Name 41 × "a"}); then ErrExists; ErrBadName; ErrBadName; ErrBadName; List still 2
4. given the file written by example 2, Open(base) again; when List; Get("zeta"); then equal field by field to the first registry's List (times round-trip through JSON); Get returns the zeta project
5. given the registry after example 2; type S struct{ N int `json:"n"` }; when SaveState("alpha", S{7}); LoadState("alpha", &out); LoadState("zeta", &out2); SaveState("nope", S{1}); LoadState("nope", &out3); then nil; nil and out == S{7}; ErrNoState; ErrNotFound; ErrNotFound; base/alpha/state.json exists with mode & 0o777 == 0o600 and base/alpha mode & 0o777 == 0o700
6. given base/projects.json holding the text {not json; when Open; then (nil, an error beginning "registry: read ")
7. given the registry of example 1 after Add({Name "alpha", Language "go", Dir "/p/alpha"}); when p := List(); p[0].Name = "changed"; p = append(p, Project{Name: "extra"}); g, _ := Get("alpha"); g.Name = "changed"; then List() and Get("alpha"); then List() is exactly []Project{{Name: "alpha", Language: "go", Dir: "/p/alpha"}} and Get("alpha") returns that project, nil: writes to returned values never reach the registry

Behaviour: Declares in registry/registry.go: `var ErrNotFound = errors.New("project not found")`, `var ErrExists = errors.New("project exists")`, `var ErrBadName = errors.New("bad project name")`, `var ErrNoState = errors.New("no state")`, `type Project struct { Name string `json:"name"`; Language string `json:"language"`; RepoURL string `json:"repo_url"`; Dir string `json:"dir"`; Caps queue.Caps `json:"caps"`; CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"` }`, `type Registry struct` (unexported fields), `func Open(base string) (*Registry, error)`, `func (r *Registry) Base() string`, `func (r *Registry) Add(p Project) error`, `func (r *Registry) Get(name string) (Project, error)`, `func (r *Registry) List() []Project`, `func (r *Registry) SaveState(name string, v any) error` and `func (r *Registry) LoadState(name string, v any) error`. Open creates base (0o700) when missing and reads base/projects.json: missing → empty; not a JSON array of Project → (nil, an error beginning "registry: read "). Add: Name must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$ else ErrBadName; a stored name → ErrExists; else stored and the whole list written as a JSON array sorted by Name (json.MarshalIndent with two spaces, an empty list as []) to a temporary file in base then renamed onto projects.json. Get → the project or (Project{}, ErrNotFound). List → a new slice sorted by Name (empty non-nil). SaveState writes json.MarshalIndent(v) to base/<name>/state.json (the directory created 0o700; unknown name → ErrNotFound) by temporary file and rename; LoadState unmarshals it into v, missing file → ErrNoState, unknown name → ErrNotFound. Every error of the file system is returned as is (never one of the sentinels). Values are copies.
